title: 模型塌陷流行病学：基于双层SIR动力学的合成数据污染建模
summary: 提出双层SIR/SIRS框架，将数据语料库和AI模型视为两个相互作用的种群，建模合成数据交叉污染导致的模型塌陷。推导基本再生数R0，通过情景校准和敏感性分析识别合成文本检测为高杠杆参数。GPT-2实验验证了阈值行为，多源混合可适度缓解塌陷。
summary_en: Proposes a bilayer SIR/SIRS framework modeling cross-contamination between data corpora and AI models leading to model collapse. Derives R0, identifies synthetic-text detection as high-leverage via sensitivity analysis. GPT-2 experiments confirm threshold behavior; multi-source mixing modestly attenuates collapse.
